claim: Ormskirk open-air street market runs each Thursday and Saturday 8am-4.30pm on pedestrianised Moor, Aughton and Church Streets, with up to 100 stalls selling fish, meat, fruit, veg, cheese, bread and pies.
quote: The market is open for business each Thursday and Saturday from 8.00am-4.30pm... Fresh cakes, fish, meat, fruit, vegetables, cheeses, bread, and pies

claim: The separate Ormskirk Food & Drink Market is an indoor hall on Moor Street with six street-food traders and a cocktail bar, open Thursday-Sunday with food Sat 10am-9pm.
quote: six traders serving up a variety of tasty street food... Thurs: 12pm - 9pm... Sat: 10am - 9pm

claim: Burscough Wharf, on the Leeds-Liverpool Canal a short drive north of Aughton, hosts independent eateries including Baja Mexican, Cactus Ray's Cafe & Deli, Gurkha Village Bar and Grill, Hugo's Cafe Bar, Milkie Bar, Only Scrans and The Thirsty Duck.
quote: Baja Mexican... Cactus Ray's Cafe & Deli... Gurkha Village Bar and Grill... Hugo's Cafe Bar... Milkie Bar... Only Scrans Burscough... The Thirsty Duck

claim: Liverpool Gin Distillery on Castle Street offers gin tastings at 4pm and 6.30pm and is open Tue-Thu 12pm-12am and Fri-Sun 12pm-1am; a Gin Tasting Experience runs 1 hour at £38.50pp.
quote: Monday - Closed; Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday - 12pm to 12am; Friday, Saturday, Sunday - 12pm to 1am

claim: The distillery spans four floors with a Gin Bar offering 40+ gins and a 600L copper pot still named Margaret producing Liverpool Gin on site.
quote: the ground floor features the Gin Bar home to over 40 different gins, as well as a 600L copper pot still named Margaret

claim: Black Lodge Brewing in Liverpool's Baltic Triangle runs a taproom on King's Dock Street pouring keg and cask, with resident food trader Fatback Burgers, open four days a week.
quote: The taproom serves their latest beers on keg and cask plus food from resident traders... Fatback Burgers, serves burgers when the taproom is open four days a week

claim: Southport Market on Market Street houses nine independent food traders (Tikka Bros, 600 Degrees pizza, Brunch N' Bagel, Pitamu Greek, Cake Corner, Pasta 51, Little Korean Kitchen, Lennys Smashport, Blackhurst Butchers) plus The Market Bar, open Wed-Thu 10am-10pm, Fri-Sat 10am-11pm, Sun 10am-8.30pm.
quote: Wednesday and Thursday 10am to 10pm. Friday and Saturday 10am to 11pm. Sunday 10am to 8:30pm. Closed Monday and Tuesday

claim: Birkdale Cheese Co at 42A Liverpool Road, Birkdale, Southport stocks over 150 cheeses and has traded in the village for 40+ years; open Mon-Sat 9-5, closed Sunday.
quote: Home to Over 150 Cheeses... 42A Liverpool Road, Birkdale, Southport PR8 4AY... Monday-Saturday: 9:00 - 17:00

claim: Owd Barn at Bispham, just outside Ormskirk, is a 16th-century listed barn farm shop with tea room serving farmhouse meals, cakes and fresh fruit pies plus locally-produced meat, fruit and veg.
quote: a rustic farm shop, a unique gift loft, a country store, and a charming tea room... traditional farmhouse homemade meals, cakes and ice creams

claim: Bold Street in Liverpool is the city's independent dining strip with global cuisines, anchored by Mowgli (Nisha Katona's Indian tiffin spot), Bundobust Indian-vegetarian-and-craft-beer, Maray's Middle Eastern small plates and LEAF teashop.
quote: Bold Street is the beating heart of Liverpool's independent dining scene... Mowgli, created by Nisha Katona MBE... Bundobust combines Indian vegetarian street food with craft beer... Maray serves Middle Eastern small plates

claim: Salt Dog Slim's at 79 Seel Street, Liverpool serves American-style chilli dogs in brioche, world beers and steins, open until 2-3am most nights.
quote: Salt Dog Slims is an emporium of world beers, bespoke cocktails, and American style chilli dogs... 79 Seel Street L1 4BB

claim: Lagom Bakery on Merlin Park, Ormskirk does sourdough, pastry and specialty coffee; open Wed-Sat 9-3 and Sun 9-1.
quote: Lagom Bakery specializes in sourdough, pastry, and coffee with locations in Ormskirk (open 9-3 Wed-Sat, 9-1 Sun)

claim: Bloom & Brew in Ormskirk is a takeout specialty coffee shop pouring beans from Liverpool roaster Neighbourhood Coffee plus rotating guest roasters, two minutes from Ormskirk station.
quote: takeout specialty locally roasted coffee, drinks and cakes from rotating roasters and bakers, and always has Liverpool house roasters, Neighbourhood Coffee, beans and filter packs available

claim: The Kicking Donkey near Ormskirk is a contemporary British gastropub praised for fish and chips with a crisp non-oily batter, open fire and reasonable prices.
quote: The Kicking Donkey in Ormskirk offers an exceptional experience in Contemporary British cuisine, with freshly cooked dishes made with local produce. The fish and chips are particularly noteworthy

claim: Crosby and Waterloo's St John's Road is lined with independent retailers and restaurants, with Cafe V76, The Little Deli (Buddha bowls with Crosby Coffee), Crosby Coffee Roasters and StoryHouse community café standing out for a foodie detour after Antony Gormley's Another Place on the beach.
quote: St John's Road is the west Merseyside version of Lark Lane with a whole street of independent retailers and restaurants lining up locally-sourced delicious food
